subject: Film & Cinema
title: New Queer Cinema
description: A micro-lesson that makes New Queer Cinema usable.

hook.text: In the early 1990s, LGBTQ+ filmmakers demanded to tell their own stories, their own way.

buildup.text: Directors like Todd Haynes and Gregg Araki rejected sanitized portrayals of queer life.

discovery.text: These films were raw, political, and often made in response to the AIDS crisis.

twist.text: Mainstream Hollywood later adopted queer stories — but often softened their radical edge.

climax.text: Moonlight winning Best Picture in 2017 marked a watershed that began with this movement.

punchline.text: Radical films opened doors for everyone.

quiz.question: What drove the New Queer Cinema movement?
options: LGBTQ+ filmmakers telling their own unfiltered stories
